StreamableJobStore.getMessages.includeHeld: returns all verified messages for snapshot reconstruction, independently of the pending-payment delivery cutoff
StreamableJobStore.getMessages.limit: positive safe integer; returns the next page after deduplication in ascending seq order, or all remaining messages if fewer; omitted means unlimited

StreamableJobStore.appendOutgoing.appendId: a retry with the same job and append identity returns its original sequence without reapplying counters, including after terminal log cleanup
StreamableJobStore.appendOutgoing.terminalAsk: a prompt or payment-request on a job that is already terminal is refused with JobEndedError and writes nothing; a payment-request finishes the job's running piece in the same transaction, at opts.finishedChargeMicro when that is below its price

StreamableJobStore.failJob.behavior: atomically fail a nonterminal job with a cancel reason and its verified durable history

StreamableJobStore.verifyAndCredit.creditRefused: optional; the built-in stores verify the message but apply no credit delta or binding to a job that already ended, and return creditRefused: "job_ended"; a store that omits it is treated as having applied the delta
StreamableJobStore.verifyAndCredit.landedAsBalance: optional opts.landedAsBalance; the built-in stores record the payment with status balance, kept out of message history and handler replay because it paid no ask; credit must be null
StreamableJobStore.verifyAndCredit.piece: optional credit.piece; the built-in stores append it as a running piece, bought by this payment's seq, only while the job is live and its row is bound to credit.piece.drawId

StreamableJobStore.declineJob.behavior: atomically end a nonterminal job with an open prompt or payment-request as cancelled by the caller, releasing the running piece; no_open_ask when nothing is open

JobRecord.pieces.ownership: written from the snapshot only on insert; afterwards only the transactional paths change it, and the first terminal write ends the running piece and freezes JobRecord.settlement
JobRecord.pieces.customStores: a store that saves the terminal snapshot as given keeps the settlement the SDK froze on it from the job's pieces; a draw with pieces but no frozen settlement is settled from those pieces and the snapshot's ending

CreditLedgerLike.cardRecovery.behavior: Required for card refunds; serialize refund/recovery per credit across machines, honor the callback query connection, persist plans and submission attempts before external calls, and compare expected state/revision. Missing entry revisions mean zero and retain legacy idempotency keys.

StripeCheckoutStore.behavior: Preserve the random store namespace in the same database/schema as the ledger and replay store. Create after sizing/admission; commit before Stripe. Never call Stripe inside withRecord. Use nonwaiting CAS for client polls, bounded internal contention retries, a short creation/refund lease, and per-row recovery scheduling. Persist dispute_lost as terminalReason when expiring a lost dispute. Booking joins tx with ledger/marker/outbox; refunding commits before Stripe.

signatureRequired.behavior: no envelope fields on a request requiring authentication; partial or invalid envelopes retain signature_invalid

upfrontPayment.unit: integer millisatoshis; optional integer credit micro-units and native atomic units

receiptPending.behavior: true on terminal responses while a configured signed receipt is not durably stored; omitted once receipt is present or receipts are disabled

nut24InlineResult.behavior: unsigned NUT-24 paid submits and replays return completed results inline within the configured wait; running jobs fall back to 202; completed artifact results include durable messages when their serialized UTF-8 array is at most 1048576 bytes and content is available

cardCreditFunding.unit: integer USD micro-units on the wire; integer cents on the MPP challenge
cardCreditFunding.behavior: stripe is a credit funding rail only; POST /v1/credit fund with method stripe issues and accepts an MPP method="stripe" charge, booking one funding lot per PaymentIntent; /v1/job never offers it
cardCreditFunding.callerTerms: CreditTerms.stripe carries network_id, min_micro, currency usd, and optional checkout true; parseCreditTerms and parseCreditMenu preserve these fields and reject malformed stripe blocks

paymentIntentMetadata.dvmkit_dvm_id: server canonicalDvmId, falling back to dvmId; omitted without identity; sent on creation including declined confirmations; credential metadata cannot override it
paymentIntentMetadata.chargeContext: StripeCreditRail.charge accepts optional canonicalDvmId supplied by the server; existing mpp_* metadata and idempotency keys are preserved
paymentIntentMetadata.legacyReplay: HTTP 400 idempotency_error permits one retry without the new metadata under the same key to recover a pre-upgrade charge; existing PaymentIntents keep their original metadata

cardCreditRefund.unit: integer USD micro-units for the drained credit; integer cents for refunds and the fee share
cardCreditRefund.behavior: POST /v1/credit drain with method stripe and no payout refunds card-funded credit to the card as partial refunds of the funding PaymentIntents, oldest first, less the refund's proportional share of Stripe's processing fee; card credit drains on no other method and stripe drains no other credit; a refund Stripe does not finish leaves the drain pending and a poll retries it; an expired card balance is refunded the same way and the credit closes (credit_closed); terminal refusals enter refund_blocked and are excluded before the retry limit; signed close-card-drain writes off only unpaid credit, while replan-card-drain retains successes and immediately replans the remainder under a new revision; decisions require a reason and replay by decision_id; uncertain or still-processing refunds refuse recovery; written_off is terminal and does not represent a successful refund

paymentInProgress.behavior: a cancel, or a message that would end a job, waits at most 5 seconds for a payment on that job being verified, then answers payment_in_progress with Retry-After and changes nothing

pieceSettlement.unit: integer micro-units of the job credit's currency
pieceSettlement.behavior: each payment buys the next piece of work and a piece finishes at the next payment-request or completion; every ending charges finished pieces, a caller cancel also charges the running piece, and failure, decline and expiry release it; decline answers 201 or 409 no_open_ask; receipt credit.amount is the charged amount

x402Route.behavior: capabilities offered on the x402 channel take one unsigned x402 request each, with the definition's input as the flat JSON body; an unpaid request is quoted from its body, and on a listed capability an empty or invalid unpaid body is quoted from listing.example; an invalid paid body, signed-request fields or any other payment rail answer 400 before verification; a paid request answers once within the capability's maxRuntimeSeconds plus the facilitator timeout from arrival: 200 charged with messages when their serialized UTF-8 array is at most 1048576 bytes, 500 or 503 not_charged, 402 not_charged with PAYMENT-RESPONSE success false, or 202 payment_pending with charge_outcome unknown and Retry-After; every response carries DVM-Job-Identity-V1

x402Listing.behavior: a capability listed on the x402 channel declares, on its route's v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED only, a resource whose url is the public origin, then the host's mount prefix, then /v1/x402/{capability}, or listing.resourceUrl when set, with the listing's description, mimeType application/json and any serviceName, tags and iconUrl, plus an extensions.bazaar that upstream validateDiscoveryExtension accepts with method POST and bodyType json; the v1 JSON body and an unlisted capability carry neither; every payload the server sends a facilitator on verify or settle carries the server's resource and extensions in place of the caller's, on the route, /v1/job deferred and upfront exact, /v1/credit, mid-job top-ups and reusable-channel payments, whose resource is /v1/credit; a facilitator's EXTENSION-RESPONSES header is logged and never returned; the route's PAYMENT-RESPONSE carries only success, transaction, network, payer and an errorReason of at most 128 characters

x402Info.behavior: capabilities offered on the x402 channel are listed under x402_capabilities, keyed by published name, apart from the unchanged dvmkit-protocol capabilities map; each entry is the capabilities entry shape with the route's flat body schema as input_schema, the x402 definition's price, and url, the route address including the host's mount prefix; the key is omitted when no capability is offered on x402

cardCreditCheckout.unit: integer USD micro-units; checkout.expires_at is Unix seconds
cardCreditCheckout.behavior: Signed stripe fund via checkout creates one hosted session per fund_id and returns 202 pending. Freshly signed polls preserve the binding and book a paid PaymentIntent once through normal card accounting. checkout_expired is terminal after expiry or refund claim; unsupported checkout directs the caller to omit via and use the token path.
cardCreditCheckout.recovery: Short nonwaiting Postgres CAS transactions book ledger/marker/outbox atomically. Stripe calls never hold a connection. A durable DVM/store binding and create/refund leases scope work; unshown creates expire after 30 minutes without adoption. Paid unbooked sessions refund after 24 hours; failed recovery backs off per row and is ordered by its next attempt time. Internal bookkeeping retries brief row contention. Won, warning_closed and prevented disputes refund what is still owed after prior refunds and lost dispute amounts. Full losses expire with terminalReason dispute_lost and release hosted closure; open and appeal disputes back off. Unreadable sessions retain the obligation and emit permission-denied or missing-session diagnostics.

CashuConfig.unsignedResultWaitSeconds.behavior: 0 disables the bounded inline result wait for unsigned NUT-24 submits and replays

CashuConfig.advertiseRefundDelay.behavior: true adds refund_delay (the enforced lock window plus 600 seconds) to the NUT-24 X-Cashu payment request; false leaves the request unchanged
